dialogue-game-implementer.description: Implements the user-approved exact dialogue artwork across the existing game, bottom-anchored, preserving story and controls.
dialogue-game-implementer.prompt:
Implement the approved dialogue bubble throughout the existing Nintendo Blue Ocean game.

Human authorization (2026-10-22): "Make the name text in the name tag white and everything is approved. Make sure during the implementation, the dialogue box is at the bottom, not hovering in the middle like in the preview html. After finalisation of the preview, create a subagent instance in Claude Code cli and let it implement the dialogue changes to the entire game." Preview finalization is complete and verified (62 checks); see previews/dialogue-bubble-prototype/PREVIEW_APPROVED_FINAL.md.

Ownership: you are the sole implementation editor. Parent lead only monitors and reviews. Work within C:\Users\robwa\Desktop\Nintendo. Production implementation belongs in blue-ocean-game. Do not push, deploy, spend money on external services, change global settings, rewrite the story, rename characters, change 3D characters/cameras or touch unrelated work. There is no git repository; preserve existing files. Before editing each existing production file, copy its original bytes to agent-reports/dialogue-integration-20261022/backups/ preserving relative paths. Record original/final hashes and exact changed-file inventory. Do not overwrite existing backups or restore old versions.

Read CLAUDE.md and the required four design/spec/plan/asset documents fully, latest BUILD_STATUS.md, CHARACTER_PERSONAS.md, relevant project skills (.claude/skills/game-qa/SKILL.md and game-architecture/SKILL.md; nintendo-game-design for contracts). Apply relevant guidance without unrelated refactors. This is a single CLI subagent, not the older interactive team takeover. Do not start further agents.

Read the FINAL preview: PREVIEW_APPROVED_FINAL.md, PREVIEW_STATUS_TAG_COLOURS.md, index.html, complete style.css, name-tag-colours.css, preview.js and dialogue-template-clean.png. Inspect its white-name screenshots. The cleaned PNG is the authoritative approved artwork; retain its exact dimensions/proportions, silhouette, striped rim, transparent exterior, dark alpha, ivory tag edge and source chevron. Do NOT trace or redraw the bubble or reintroduce dots/checkers. Reuse its exact tag fill layer (inline SVG path generated from source pink pixels) or another equally exact portable implementation. Runtime code must use local bundled assets and respect import.meta.env.BASE_URL. Copy only needed final runtime artwork into public/assets with project conventions; never reference Desktop paths or the previews folder at runtime.

Critical layout: the game dialogue must be bottom-anchored in screen-space, with a small safe-area bottom gap (~16-24 px at normal desktop sizes), visibly near the bottom at 1920x1080, 1366x768 and 1024x768. Do not import preview headers/footers/controls or its middle/hovering layout. Keep original artwork aspect ratio, tune overall responsive scale and copy sizing/padding for the actual game's long lines. Use a single shared dialogue component across opening/narrator, all chapters/advisors, consequence/feedback, boss, transition and finale dialogue. Do not leave old styled speech variants in any speaking phase. Keep all live name/copy/continue nodes and accessible button semantics, clean show/hide behavior, no duplicate source arrow, and make all dialogue strings fit without cropping or font illegibility. Ensure choices, presenter toolbar, stage and source citations remain usable, hidden dialogue does not intercept clicks, and modal z-order stays sound.

Colors: white live speaker name text for EVERY speaker. Preserve the actual game's approved display names from CHARACTER_PERSONAS.md and ids: Slyvester/pip uses approved blue #67aeca, Hootley/mori approved green #6aa87b, Pawson/grumble approved pink #d27ba6. Assign a distinct compatible amber to Damian/bolt and lavender to Shelldon/shell, neutral slate for narrator. Keep this UI palette separate from CharacterProfile colors so 3D materials/voice/persona are not changed. Preserve the existing live reveal/advance, 160ms guard, reduced-motion handling, audio/babble stop, manual hold, keyboard, saved state, character focus, factory and presenter semantics. Do not replace the existing engine with the prototype's demo JS or sample text.

Validation: run npm run typecheck, npm test and npm run build. Use installed Playwright and relevant existing interaction/canonical flow tests. Add focused meaningful layout/asset/speaker-color/name-white assertions where appropriate (do not weaken existing story tests or blindly replace snapshots). Actually exercise a complete 3-chapter/4-vote flow through factory/feedback/boss/transitions/finale, check reset/reload/mute/skip enough to catch integration regressions. Inspect and screenshot bottom-anchored dialogue for all five real speakers and narrator at 1920/1366, plus long-line/name fit at 1024. Record box bottom gap and text/name overflow; inspect visually. Test built local preview and relative/subpath asset loading, zero missing runtime assets and zero page errors. Avoid repeatedly running the full 12-minute broad suite unless required; targeted existing tests plus canonical walkthrough and build are appropriate. Keep QA artifacts isolated from other runs. No new runtime dependency or external asset download.

Deliver agent-reports/dialogue-integration-20261022/IMPLEMENTATION.md with exact modified paths, commands/results, bottom-gap measurements, all-speaker coverage, visual evidence, known actual limitations, and how to run/open. Update BUILD_STATUS.md with a concise new section and preserve its history. Finish only after changes are implemented and checked, not merely planned. If blocked, record exact cause and completed work, never claim success without evidence.
